It uses the same sheet, receipt and let-go as Needs your attention. Review tightened it so Delete never shows on a Studio or soundbite row before the phone knows it can let its own copy go, and the page says it is counting meanwhile. LA19, the discard-sites rows, CLAUDE.md and the ledger's receipt growth line now say My data too.

calls.title: My data waits for the Soundbites page before offering Delete on a soundbite
options: wait for the Soundbites page to be opened, and say so
My data's soundbite page hands the soundbites' store in itself, as Needs your attention does
calls.why: It matches how Studio already works, and handing the store in from Settings would also start sending soundbites from there, which the owner would notice.
calls.undo: Hand the soundbites' store in from My data's soundbite page and read the page again once it is in (C461).
